AI MARKET SYNOPSIS

The market is conflating 'expensive rate environment' with 'all growth is uninvestable' while simultaneously ignoring high-quality cash generators that clear a 5%+ FCF yield bar with ease. The real opportunity sits in: (1) quality compounders with 40%+ FCF margins trading at mid-teen PEs due to sector stigma or undercoverage, and (2) specialty insurers and government IT contractors where FCF yields of 10-18% dwarfs the 4.41% 10Y Treasury.
